open_uri_with_pathmanager: open a local or remote URI as a file-like object using PathManager.open with mode and buffering args
async_open_with_pathmanager: open a file for non-blocking async writes using PathManager.opena then call async_join and async_close
copy_file_across_handlers: copy a file between local and remote URIs using PathManager.copy with an overwrite flag
get_local_path_for_uri: resolve a remote URI to a cached local file path using PathManager.get_local_path with force download
file_lock_context_manager: acquire a file-level lock using file_lock as a context manager to prevent concurrent cache writes
